pages.title: About us - Holmen Fondsforvaltning
pages.main_text_excerpt:
Holmen Fondsforvaltning AS is an independent investment company focused on the long-term management of Holmen Spesialfond. The company was founded in 2011 and is regulated by the Financial Supervisory Authority of Norway (“Finanstilsynet”). Holmen Spesialfond has an equity long-only strategy investing in underpriced stocks predominantly in the Nordics regardless of sector.
Our mission is Investing for the next generation and thereby realizing the time value of money. We believe this is best accomplished through our core values based on a long-term view, passion for equities, independent thinking, simplicity and honesty and aligned interests.
